newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa flips up to end at day's peak.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa flips up to end at day's peak.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures flipped higher towards the close on Wednesday on short-covering buying.
Traders said shorts returned to cover their positions after the market failed to make much headway on the downside this morning.

September, which successfully defended its immediate support at 1,000 stg this morning, charged back to end at the day's high of 1,025 stg per tonne, up eight stg on the day. Traders said more gains were seen as many were still short in the market.
Volume at 6,364 lots was inflated by 3,0000 AA trades on December and crosses. One house crossed 2,500 lots of December at 1,042.
Chartwise, a bigger support after 1,000 lies at 980 stg and then the most recent low of 965. Tuesday's peak of 1,028 forms the initial resistance, followed by 1,045.
Sept/Dec switches were traded at 36 stg and Dec/March 24-25 stg.
In other news, the International Cocoa Organisation has invited bids for 4,250 tonnes of buffer stock cocoaby 1140 GMT on Thursday.
